mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those which change by managerial decision."
Relevant and Irrelevant Costs Relevant costs are those which change by managerial decision.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those variable costs which are directly related to the production or sales level."
Engineered variable costs are those variable costs which are directly related to the production or sales level.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a predetermined calculation of how much costs should be under specific working conditions."
A standard cost is a predetermined calculation of how much costs should be under specific working conditions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the costing techniques management relies upon when considering costs for the purpose of ascertaining profit figures."
Marginal costing is one of the costing techniques management relies upon when considering costs for the purpose of ascertaining profit figures.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a part of opportunity cost."
Implicit Cost Implicit costs are a part of opportunity cost.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the actual or outlay costs that point out the amount of expenditure that has already been incurred on a particular process or on production."
Accounting Costs Accounting costs are the actual or outlay costs that point out the amount of expenditure that has already been incurred on a particular process or on production.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an expense which contains both a fixed-cost component and a variable-cost component."
Semi-Variable Cost - Semi-variable cost is an expense which contains both a fixed-cost component and a variable-cost component.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the regulation of cost of operating a business and is concerned with keeping costs within acceptable limits."
Cost control is the regulation of cost of operating a business and is concerned with keeping costs within acceptable limits.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an official document of the firm, which explores the entire financial information of the firm."
A financial statement is an official document of the firm, which explores the entire financial information of the firm.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those which will not be eliminated with the segment."
Unavoidable costs are those which will not be eliminated with the segment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the smallest segment of activity or area of responsibility for which costs are accumulated or ascertained."
Cost centres are the smallest segment of activity or area of responsibility for which costs are accumulated or ascertained.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is that which measures the difference between the current assets and current liabilities which is an expression of the company's potential funds reserved."
Net Working Capital ratio is that which measures the difference between the current assets and current liabilities which is an expression of the company's potential funds reserved.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the cost of producing an extra unit."
Marginal Costs - Marginal cost is the cost of producing an extra unit.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a situation where a business organization maintains more materials than is necessary at any given time."
Overstocking is a situation where a business organization maintains more materials than is necessary at any given time.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those expenses/expenditures that are actually paid by the firm."
Explicit Cost Explicit costs are those expenses/expenditures that are actually paid by the firm.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the cost or expenditure which a firm incurs for producing or acquiring a good or service."
Actual Cost Actual cost is defined as the cost or expenditure which a firm incurs for producing or acquiring a good or service.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of tracking the expenses incurred on a job against the revenue produced by that job."
Job Costing Job costing is the process of tracking the expenses incurred on a job against the revenue produced by that job.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those do not alter by varying the nature or level of business activity."
Sunk Cost Sunk costs are those do not alter by varying the nature or level of business activity.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those which cannot be easily and definitely identifiable in relation to a plant, a product, a process or a department."
Indirect Costs Indirect costs are those which cannot be easily and definitely identifiable in relation to a plant, a product, a process or a department.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those business costs that are not directly related to the level of production or output."
Fixed Costs Fixed costs are those business costs that are not directly related to the level of production or output.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the second element of cost, and one of the most important."
Labour is the second element of cost, and one of the most important.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the point at which revenue is exactly equal to costs."
The break-even point is the point at which revenue is exactly equal to costs.

accounts and documents

Costing

Labour cost
